final: SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_ram) AS avg_ram_gb, AVG(site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS site_avg_ram, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) AS per_site GROUP BY entrystat
